liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Bird Song with a West LA Fadeaway sandwiched inside the first-set highlight [12]
- **Slipknot!** (1 review): Reviewer describes the Slipknot! as intensely powerful, in a second set opening with Help, Slip, Frank [12]
- **William Tell Bridge** (1 review): Reviewer thought the William Tell Overture morphed into a jam resembling an electric Billy Strings [14]
- **One More Saturday Night** (1 review): Because of the merged track, this song actually falls at track 20 rather than the listed position [7]
- **Jack-A-Roe** (1 review): Reviewer notes the track labeled Jackero is normally spelled Jack-A-Roe by the Dead and Dylan [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Jackero**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **William Tell Bridge**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 14 archived performances [15]
- **Drum Solo**: rare: 7 archived performances [15]
- Earliest performances in the archive: The Eleven [15]

## The recordings

- **DeadCo2018-06-16.DeadCo2018-06-16_163.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 185 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **deadandcompany2018-06-16.neumann_skm150.sunboy.flac24**: source not stated; 22 songs; 189 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **dead2018-06-16.ccm4v.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 183 min; rated 4/5 by 7 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the recording good, but notes a track-labeling error: William Tell Bridge and The Eleven share one track, shifting later tracks; Reviewer calls it a fabulous audience recording, though several tracks are mislabeled [7][11]
- **deadandcompany2018-06-16.neumann_skm150.sunboy.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 189 min [4]

## Around the show

- Uploader worked at both Citi Field shows, setting up front-of-board with Jon and Joel, and caught only parts of each set [8]
- Reviewer describes high-energy, creative jamming on this final night of the Citi Field run [11]
- Taped in the general admission field, just in front of the mixer enclosure, about 15 feet left of center [2]
- Taped from the main floor, about 60 feet from stage and 6 feet high, using clamp space from Jon Pasternack [3]
- Reviewer says the second set was epic, and rates this night among the Citi Field shows, ahead of Camden and Raleigh [6]
- Reviewer saw five shows on the 2018 tour and ranks this best, also best of all their Citi Field shows [12]
- Attendee of all Citi Field runs calls this the best show the band played there and the best of the year [13]
- Reviewer found the show unremarkable, with a lot of noodling, though the band's direction is unpredictable [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **DeadCo2018-06-16.DeadCo2018-06-16_163.flac16**: taped by Jon Pasternak; transferred by StPatric; source: AUD [1]. Also: Oade M248 mics into Sound Devices 722 at 24/48, then Izotope RX, Adobe Audition, CDwave, TLH, FLAC 16 [1]
- **deadandcompany2018-06-16.neumann_skm150.sunboy.flac24**: taped by Steven Weld; transferred by Steven Weld; source: Neumann SKM150(AK50's/LC3's/KM100's)>GAKables xlr>Lunatec V2>GAKables xlr>Apogee Mini-Me@24/96>AES/EBU>Sound Devices 722 @24bit/96kHz ~ [2]
- **dead2018-06-16.ccm4v.flac16**: taped by Z-Man; source: Schoeps CCM4V's>Lunatec V2>Sound Devices 722 (24/44) [3]. Also: Torrent was transferred to this site by Sean; the taper uploaded after staying up until 5:30 before flying out; Schoeps CCM4V mics through Lunatec V2 into Sound Devices 722 at 24/44, then Sound Forge and CD Wave to FLAC 16 [3][8]
- **deadandcompany2018-06-16.neumann_skm150.sunboy.flac16**: taped by Steven Weld; transferred by Steven Weld; source: Neumann SKM150(AK50's/LC3's/KM100's)>GAKables xlr>Lunatec V2>GAKables xlr>Apogee Mini-Me@24/96>AES/EBU>Sound Devices 722 @24bit/96kHz ~ [4]
